summary: Clene Inc. filed an 8-K to report a second amendment to its senior secured convertible promissory notes with certain holders. The amendment extends the maturity date to August 13, 2027 or upon a change of control, and defers monthly principal and interest payments of $1,000,000 due September 2026 to the maturity date. The filing also includes first quarter 2026 financial results. This is a routine debt modification and earnings release, not a special situation such as a restructuring or strategic review. It does not involve terms typical of a special situation category.
